description:
PWC user-mistake Socratic-coaching surface (2026-05-27). Fires when caption_pipeline.inject_socratic_user_facts stamped socratic_is_active=True (severity in {mistake,blunder} AND none of the three suppression gates fired: cp_loss<80, user-addresses-threat, known opening theory). Produces the multi-field SocraticExtras shape that smart_coaching.generate_smart_user_feedback produces today via an LLM call — but deterministically, from caption_facts.

Unlike R01-R15 (single-caption rules), R18 variants are OBJECTS with narrative / plan / question / hint fields. Rendered by populate_socratic_extras in caption_pipeline.py — NOT through the generic render_rule path. Variant selection still uses select_variant predicates against caption_facts.

Per Mohit 2026-05-27 ("use same direction") — mirror the coach-move migration (PR-1 through PR-5, R17_coach_move). See [[one-source-of-truth-for-coaching]].

fact_glossary.socratic_is_active: Gate flag — true when inject_socratic_user_facts stamped it AND none of the three suppression gates fired
fact_glossary.socratic_fundamental_violated: hanging_pieces | check_opponents_move | calculate | king_safety | development | center_control | have_a_plan | None
fact_glossary.socratic_opponent_threat_type: 'fork' | 'mate' | 'capture' | None (set only for blunders when post-move position exposes a concrete threat)
fact_glossary.socratic_hanging_piece: Piece-name of the user's hanging piece on post-move board (when fundamental_violated=hanging_pieces)
fact_glossary.socratic_hanging_square: Square of the hanging piece (when fundamental_violated=hanging_pieces)
fact_glossary.socratic_problem_facts_joined: Computed by renderer: socratic_problem_facts list joined with semicolons for embedding into narrative
fact_glossary.socratic_recovery_facts_joined: Computed by renderer: socratic_recovery_facts list joined with semicolons for the plan field
fact_glossary.socratic_user_rating: Rating bucket for variant selection if needed

blunder_hanging_with_mate.narrative: Wait — your {socratic_hanging_piece} on {socratic_hanging_square} is hanging AND the opponent has a mate threat: {socratic_opponent_threat_text}.
blunder_hanging_with_mate.plan: Step one is mate. Address it first. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_hanging_with_fork.narrative: Wait — your {socratic_hanging_piece} on {socratic_hanging_square} is hanging AND the opponent now has a fork: {socratic_opponent_threat_text}.
blunder_hanging_with_fork.plan: Two attacks at once means you have to pick. Save the most valuable piece. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_hanging_with_capture.narrative: Your {socratic_hanging_piece} on {socratic_hanging_square} is hanging — and the opponent can take it next move.
blunder_hanging_with_capture.plan: Move the piece, defend it, or find a counter-threat. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_hanging.plan: Before every move, count attackers vs defenders on every piece you own. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_threat_mate.narrative: The opponent now has a mate threat: {socratic_opponent_threat_text}.
blunder_threat_mate.plan: Forced moves first. Resolve the mate threat before anything else. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_threat_fork.narrative: The opponent now has a double attack: {socratic_opponent_threat_text}.
blunder_threat_fork.plan: Pick the more valuable target. Accept losing the other, or find a counter-tempo move. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_threat_capture.narrative: The opponent now has a free capture: {socratic_opponent_threat_text}.
blunder_threat_capture.plan: Defend the piece, move it, or trade it. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_calculate.narrative: You didn't calculate the opponent's response. {socratic_problem_facts_joined}
blunder_calculate.plan: Before each move, ask: what's their best reply? {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_king_safety.narrative: Your king is in danger now. {socratic_problem_facts_joined}
blunder_king_safety.plan: King safety beats material. Get the king to a safer square. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_missed_threat.narrative: You didn't respond to the opponent's last move. {socratic_problem_facts_joined}
blunder_missed_threat.plan: Always pause after the opponent moves: what did they just do? {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

blunder_generic.narrative: This was a major mistake — the position got significantly worse.
blunder_generic.plan: Slow down. Check what changed on the board before each move. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_hanging.narrative: Good idea, but your {socratic_hanging_piece} on {socratic_hanging_square} is now undefended.
mistake_hanging.plan: Always count defenders vs attackers before each move. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_missed_threat.narrative: You didn't address the opponent's last move. {socratic_problem_facts_joined}
mistake_missed_threat.plan: Pause after each opponent move — what new threat appeared? {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_calculate.narrative: You didn't fully calculate the opponent's response. {socratic_problem_facts_joined}
mistake_calculate.plan: Try to see one or two moves ahead before committing. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_king_safety.plan: Keep pawns in front of your king and watch for open lines. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_development.narrative: You moved a developed piece instead of bringing a new one out.
mistake_development.plan: Develop knights and bishops first. Don't move the same piece twice in the opening. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_center_control.narrative: You lost some control of the center. {socratic_problem_facts_joined}
mistake_center_control.plan: Pieces and pawns in the center give you the most options. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_have_a_plan.narrative: Your move doesn't have a clear purpose — it didn't develop, attack, defend, or improve king safety.
mistake_have_a_plan.plan: Each move should do one of: develop, attack, defend, or improve king safety. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}

mistake_generic.narrative: This was a mistake — there was a stronger move available.
mistake_generic.plan: Before each move, list 2-3 candidate moves and compare them. {socratic_recovery_facts_joined}
